# Proverbs 24 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Do-not-envy men-of evil, and-do-not-desire to-be with-them,

**2** For destruction their-heart meditates, and-trouble their-lips speak.

**3** By-wisdom a-house is-built, and-by-understanding it-is-established,

**4** And-by-knowledge [the]-rooms are-filled [with]-all wealth precious and-pleasant.

**5** A-man wise [is]-in-strength, and-a-man-of knowledge strengthens power.

**6** For by-wise-guidance you-shall-make your-war, and-victory [is] in-[the]-multitude-of counselors.

**7** Too-high for-a-fool [are]-wisdoms; in-[the]-gate he-does-not-open his-mouth.

**8** One-planning to-do-evil — 'master-of schemes' they-call-him.

**9** [The]-plan-of folly [is] sin, and-an-abomination to-mankind [is the]-scoffer.

**10** If you-show-yourself-slack in-[the]-day-of distress, narrow [is] your-strength.

**11** Deliver those-being-taken to-death, and-those-tottering to-[the]-slaughter — if you-hold-back,

**12** If you-say, 'Behold, we-did-not-know this,' does-not [the]-One-weighing hearts — He understands? And-[the]-One-keeping your-soul — He knows? And-He-repays to-a-man according-to his-work.

**13** Eat honey, my-son, for [it is]-good, and-drippings [are]-sweet upon your-palate.

**14** So know — wisdom for-your-soul; if you-find [it], then-there-is a-future, and-your-hope will-not be-cut-off.

**15** Do-not-lie-in-wait, wicked-one, against-[the]-dwelling-of [the]-righteous; do-not-devastate his-resting-place,

**16** For seven-[times] [the]-righteous falls and-rises, but-[the]-wicked stumble in-evil.

**17** When-your-enemy falls do-not-rejoice, and-when-he-stumbles let-not your-heart be-glad,

**18** Lest YHWH sees and-[it is]-evil in-His-eyes, and-He-turns-away from-upon-him His-anger.

**19** Do-not-fret because-of evildoers; do-not-envy [the]-wicked,

**20** For not will-be a-future for-[the]-evil; [the]-lamp-of [the]-wicked will-be-extinguished.

**21** Fear YHWH, my-son, and-[the]-king; with-[those-who]-change do-not-mix-yourself,

**22** For suddenly their-calamity will-rise, and-[the]-ruin-of both-of-them — who knows?

**23** These also [are] for-[the]-wise. To-show-partiality in-judgment [is]-not good.

**24** One-saying to-[the]-wicked, 'You [are]-righteous' — peoples will-curse-him, nations will-denounce-him.

**25** But-for-those-rebuking [it will be]-pleasant, and-upon-them will-come a-blessing-of good.

**26** Lips he-kisses — one-returning words right.

**27** Prepare outside your-work, and-make-ready-it for-yourself in-the-field; afterward build your-house.

**28** Do-not-be a-witness against-your-neighbor without-cause, and-would-you-deceive with-your-lips?

**29** Do-not-say, 'As he-did to-me so I-will-do to-him; I-will-repay [the]-man according-to his-work.'

**30** By [the]-field-of a-man lazy I-passed, and-by-[the]-vineyard-of a-man lacking heart,

**31** And-behold, it-had-come-up all-of-it [with]-thorns; covered its-face [with]-nettles, and-its-wall-of stones was-torn-down.

**32** And-I-beheld; I — I-set my-heart; I-saw — I-received discipline.

**33** A-little sleep, a-little slumber, a-little folding-of [the]-hands to-lie-down,

**34** And-your-poverty will-come walking, and-your-want like-a-man-of [the]-shield.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **24:11-12**: A powerful ethical imperative — you cannot claim ignorance when people are in danger. God weighs the heart and knows your true awareness.

- **24:16**: Sheva yippol tzaddiq ve-qam — 'seven times falls the righteous and rises.' Seven = completeness. The righteous falls repeatedly but always recovers.

- **24:27**: Practical economic wisdom — establish productive capacity (fields) before building your house. Infrastructure before luxury.

— EMET
